cot.paper: Li et al. (2022), Competition-Level Code Generation with AlphaCode
cot.conversion: Generate reasoning from accepted solutions; retain only solutions passing tests and reasoning/code consistency checks.

style.paper: Lu et al. (2021), CodeXGLUE; Tufano et al. (2019)
style.conversion: Filter before/after pairs to style and organization edits; exclude bug-only and rename-only changes.

ast.hub_command: External download or mine Git history with RefactoringMiner
ast.conversion: Parse both sides, store AST edit evidence, exclude formatting-only and identifier-only changes, then run tests.

variable.paper: Lu et al. (2021), CodeXGLUE; Allamanis et al. (2015)
variable.conversion: Combine definition-use examples with Rename Variable commits or AST renaming to produce semantic before/after pairs.

control_flow.paper: Karampatsis and Sutton (2020), Maybe Deep Learning Can Have a Role in Code Simplification
control_flow.conversion: Keep only condition/loop/return-path changes, add differential tests, and record the Java-language limitation.
